_about: D1b: the meters' numbers, loaded by sim/core/fighter_data.gd into a MetersDef (f.md) and read by fighter.gd (regen, decay), damage.gd (damage_mul, comeback, composure), world/collateral.gd (sources) and director/beam.gd (beam_power). Casualty and evacuee amounts are per person, normalised by 425 / pop0. The range and start are pinned to 0 to 100 and 0 until F1.

sources._note: people this fighter's blows forced to flee

effects._note: ki regen + perPoint x menace, at most cap (Game Design: 0.01, at most +1)
x (1 + cap x menace / 100) (Game Design: +5% at full menace; was 15%)
beam clash power + perPoint x menace
